targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value, CASE WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-stable' THEN 'WL-001' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-fluctuating' THEN 'WL-002' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-elevated' THEN 'WL-003' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-rapid-rise' THEN 'WL-004' WHEN sensor_id = 'quickstart' THEN 'WL-000' WHEN sensor_id ~ '^demo-alert-[0-9a-f]{12}-(level|rise)-(warning|critical)$' THEN 'WL-' || split_part(sensor_id, '-', 3) || '-' || CASE split_part(sensor_id, '-', 4) || '-' || split_part(sensor_id, '-', 5) WHEN 'level-warning' THEN '005' WHEN 'level-critical' THEN '006' WHEN 'rise-warning' THEN '007' ELSE '008' END ELSE sensor_id END AS metric FROM sensor.dashboard_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type LIKE 'water-level%' ORDER BY time

SELECT time, CASE WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-stable' THEN 'WL-001' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-fluctuating' THEN 'WL-002' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-elevated' THEN 'WL-003' WHEN sensor_id = 'demo-rapid-rise' THEN 'WL-004' WHEN sensor_id = 'quickstart' THEN 'WL-000' WHEN sensor_id ~ '^demo-alert-[0-9a-f]{12}-(level|rise)-(warning|critical)$' THEN 'WL-' || split_part(sensor_id, '-', 3) || '-' || CASE split_part(sensor_id, '-', 4) || '-' || split_part(sensor_id, '-', 5) WHEN 'level-warning' THEN '005' WHEN 'level-critical' THEN '006' WHEN 'rise-warning' THEN '007' ELSE '008' END ELSE sensor_id END AS station, sensor_id, sensor_type, value, unit, longitude, latitude, location_id, metadata FROM sensor.dashboard_values ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN r.sensor_id = 'demo-stable' THEN 'WL-001' WHEN r.sensor_id = 'demo-fluctuating' THEN 'WL-002' WHEN r.sensor_id = 'demo-elevated' THEN 'WL-003' WHEN r.sensor_id = 'demo-rapid-rise' THEN 'WL-004' WHEN r.sensor_id = 'quickstart' THEN 'WL-000' WHEN r.sensor_id ~ '^demo-alert-[0-9a-f]{12}-(level|rise)-(warning|critical)$' THEN 'WL-' || split_part(r.sensor_id, '-', 3) || '-' || CASE split_part(r.sensor_id, '-', 4) || '-' || split_part(r.sensor_id, '-', 5) WHEN 'level-warning' THEN '005' WHEN 'level-critical' THEN '006' WHEN 'rise-warning' THEN '007' ELSE '008' END ELSE r.sensor_id END AS station, location.location_id, r.sensor_id, a.kind, a.severity, a.opened_at, a.acknowledged_at, a.acknowledged_by FROM alerting.alerts a JOIN configuration.alert_rules r ON r.id=a.rule_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT location_id FROM sensor.dashboard_values WHERE sensor_id=r.sensor_id ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) location ON true WHERE a.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.opened_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT last_success_at, schedule_seconds, last_success_at > now() - make_interval(secs => schedule_seconds * 3) AS evaluator_healthy FROM alerting.evaluator_status
